Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing spas and art galleries to serve wine to their customers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing spas and art galleries to serve wine totheir customers who are twentyone years of age or older; and addingnew sections to chapter 66.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Nothing in this title applies to or prevents a spa or artgallery from offering or supplying without charge wine by theindividual glass to a customer for consumption on the premises.However, the customer must be at least twentyone years of age and mayonly be offered one glass of wine, and the wine must have been legallypurchased under this title. If the wine is offered by a spa thatprovides massages, the wine may not be offered to the customer untilthe massage is completed. (2) For the purposes of this section, "spa" means a business thatoffers beauty services including, but not limited to, shampooing,cutting, styling, or dyeing hair, manicures, pedicures, facials,massages, and the use of body toning equipment. p. 1 SSB 6703 (3) For purposes of this section, "art gallery" means a room orbuilding devoted to the exhibition and/or sale of the works of art.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The board may adopt rules to implement section 1 of this act.
